title: carex flava var. viridula
intro: Carex flava var. viridula, commonly known as the green leaved sedge, is a type of perennial plant belonging to the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
